## Functions

### Markdown()

```ts
function Markdown(__namedParameters): ReactNode;
```

Shared Markdown renderer with safe links, images and highlighted code. Documents
use Caps Prose; containing surfaces can supply their own typography and element
treatments. Replacing the source renders streaming partial Markdown.
